notes.title: BACKUP YOUR SAVE FILES TODAY | THE BIG UPDATE IS COMING
notes.notes:
A new major update for our game will be released today. We recommend backing up your save files before the update. When the new update is applied, some errors may occur in your save file.

File Path: ApartmentNo129_Data\Data

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Announcement: New Release Date

Dear Followers,

We had planned to release our game in June, which we have been eagerly looking forward to sharing with you. However, as a team, we realized that we need a bit more time to continue our work and deliver the best possible experience.

Therefore, the new release date for our game has been updated to ''July 29.'' Thank you for your patience and support. Your understanding during this process is very valuable to us.

Thanks to your trust and patience, we know we will deliver an even better game. Stay tuned for updates and developments. We can't wait to bring you an amazing gaming experience!

With love and respect,
